---
title: "Columns"
format: revealjs
---

## Side by side

Put content in side-by-side columns with a `.columns` container holding two
or more `.column` divs. Each `width` becomes the column's share of the row.

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="40%"}
The left column is 40% wide.
:::

::: {.column width="60%"}
The right column takes the remaining 60%.
:::

::::
